_doc: Tool surface for the arxiv-benchmark agent. Primary set = 14 tools matching upstream codebase-memory-mcp v0.5.5 (Table 4 in arXiv:2603.27277). Secondary set = our full 36-tool surface. Apples-to-apples comparison uses primary; we run secondary to quantify the bonus-tools effect.

primary_14_tool_match.description: Apples-to-apples match with upstream's 14 tools (arXiv paper Table 4). Use this set for the comparison number cited externally.

secondary_full_set.description: Our complete tool surface including bonus tools (LocAgent variants, semantic search, security/STIG, service-level tools). Measures lift from the tools we have that upstream doesn't.

upstream_tool_semantics._doc: Reference semantics from arXiv paper Table 4 + upstream src/mcp/. Used by Phase B audit.
upstream_tool_semantics.search_graph: Symbol search by label / name pattern

mapping_notes.verified_via: code-graph cli (2026-05-12) — all 14 names appear in our CLI tool list
semantic_drift_risks: trace_call_path: upstream accepts depth param; verify our impl supports same depth range
query_graph: both implement Cypher subset; verify Cypher feature parity (we support recursive CTE; upstream uses BFS via SQLite CTE per paper)
search_code: both are FTS5-based; identical conceptually
manage_adr: both store ADR records; semantics likely identical
